descriptions.zh:
### 接口说明

调用该接口时，您需要注意：

- 如果您不想再使用日志监控功能，您可以通过此接口删除指定的日志监控。

- 请确保您已创建云存储网关，并创建网关日志监控。

 - 只有网关日志监控状态为启用中(Enabled)或禁用中(Disabled)时，才可以删除网关日志监控。

 <props="china">- 您可以通过[DescribeGatewayLogging](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/csg/developer-reference/api-describegatewaylogging)接口查询网关日志监控的状态。</props><props="intl">- 您可以通过[DescribeGatewayLogging](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/csg/developer-reference/api-describegatewaylogging?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.0.19107582L1BU5t)接口查询网关日志监控的状态。</props>
descriptions.en:
### Description

When you call this operation, note the following:

- If you no longer require the log monitoring feature, you can call this operation to delete the specified log monitoring configuration.
- Make sure that you have created a Cloud Storage Gateway (CSG) instance and enabled the log monitoring feature for the gateway.
- You can delete the log monitoring configuration only when the log monitoring feature has a status of Enabled or Disabled.
<props="china">

- You can call the [DescribeGatewayLogging](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/csg/developer-reference/api-describegatewaylogging) operation to query the status of the log monitoring feature for a gateway.

</props> <props="intl">You can call the [DescribeGatewayLogging](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/csg/developer-reference/api-describegatewaylogging?spm=a2c63.p38356.0.0.19107582L1BU5t) operation to query the status of the log monitoring feature for a gateway.</props>
